Description: Problem-discovery card descriptions used white at 55% opacity. Axe measured 4.23:1 contrast for 14px text, below 4.5:1.
Reproduction_steps: Open /services and scroll to Start with what changed. Inspect the small descriptions on the dark cards.
Recommended_fix: Increase description contrast using the existing white utility at 80% opacity.
Implemented_fix: Changed text-white/55 to text-white/80 in src/app/(marketing)/services/page.tsx.
Retest_evidence: docs\qa\2026-11-16\final\screenshots\services--desktop.jpg; final/desktop.json; final/tablet.json; final/mobile.json: no detected axe violations.

Description: The pricing strip squeezed the phone CTA into multiple text lines when copy and actions shared a tablet row.
Reproduction_steps: Open / at 768x1024 and scroll below the 3D hero to Service call pricing.
Recommended_fix: Stack copy and actions until the large breakpoint and prevent action-group and phone-label shrinking.
Implemented_fix: Updated src/components/home/pricing-strip.tsx with lg row layout, shrink-0 and whitespace-nowrap.
Retest_evidence: docs\qa\2026-11-16\final\pricing--tablet.png; pricing phone stays on one line passes in all three interaction logs.

Description: At a particular scroll position the floating chat launcher covered the end of the service-grid phone text. Measured text/button overlap was 527.06 px² on tablet and 43.31 px² on desktop.
Reproduction_steps: Scroll the service-grid phone CTA until its top is 72px above the viewport bottom. Compare its text rectangle with Open Apex Assistant.
Recommended_fix: Keep the tablet CTA aligned left below the heading and reserve a desktop right gutter for the floating launcher.
Implemented_fix: Updated src/components/home/expertise-and-standard.tsx to stack below lg, self-align the CTA and add a desktop right margin.
Retest_evidence: docs\qa\2026-11-16\final\service-call-chat-clearance--tablet.png; overlap regression measures zero in all three viewports.

Description: Long final-CTA headings shrank the action group, wrapping both the phone number and Book Now. Also reproduced on /services/cooling, /services/heating, /services/water-heater-repair and /services/heating/heating-maintenance.
Reproduction_steps: At 1440x900 open one of the affected routes and scroll to its final dark Call or book now section.
Recommended_fix: Prevent the shared action group from shrinking and keep short action labels on one line.
Implemented_fix: Updated FinalServiceCta in src/components/services/service-sections.tsx with shrink-0 and whitespace-nowrap.
Retest_evidence: docs\qa\2026-11-16\final\service-cta-appliance-repair--desktop.png; five affected routes each pass label-line assertions at all three sizes; all 12 service pages were recaptured.
